g.text: 48 resources (29 spatial cards, 9 logical resources in 8 group cards, 2 embedded route cards) · 79 relationships
Line color shows the relationship's own Terraform action, independently of endpoint-card actions.
no independent change: no separate Terraform action is identified. unchanged: an explicit no-op action.
Thin solid arrow from the referenced resource to the
dependent resource; not exact Terraform execution order.
identify the same Terraform-backed relationship at both
Dashed line from a Route to its next hop. The
destination arrow expresses direction; matching badges
Thicker dotted line shows an inferred, undirected
connection; this does not guarantee actual network
Nested boxes show containment; nesting replaces a
Hollow circles mark resource/card attachment points; neither end of an undirected line is a directional start. Filled internal
Matching [N] badges identify the same Terraform-backed relationship and its Relationship Resources entry. They do not express
direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
